name: Jason Bright, Glowing Prophet
oracle_text:
Whenever a Zombie or Mutant you control dies, if its power was different from its base power, draw a card.
Come Fly With Me — {2}, Sacrifice a creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains flying until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a Zombie or Mutant you control dies, if its power was different from its base power, draw a card.

needs.what: a last-known-information value key for the BASE power (layer 7b result, before counters and modifiers) the departed creature had as it left the battlefield, snapshotted on the dies event beside had_power, so a dies trigger's intervening-if can compare {"power_had": true} against it with cmp '!='
needs.why_existing_wont_do: power_had reads the creature's last-known derived power, but nothing snapshots its base power. power_of on the card in the graveyard returns the printed power, which is wrong for a token (it has ceased to exist, e.g. a decayed Zombie token), for a copy, and for a creature whose base P/T was set by an effect (set_pt, animate); the base_power selector key only matches objects still on the battlefield
